description: Global render mode rules. Pipeline reads this to decide which JSON prop groups to include/strip per render mode. Individual items can override via renderOverrides in content JSON.

full.label: Default
full.notes: Everything rendered — all props, all tokens, all effects

reduced.label: Calm Mode
reduced.notes: Animation props stripped. No animation classes emitted. Static visuals only.

textonly.label: Reading Mode
textonly.notes: Content only. Visual gates (dark/HC/HL) still apply via CSS. Textonly style variants add different treatments.

assistive.label: Easy Click
assistive.notes: Large targets (64px), single column, no hover-only content. Same as reduced but with layout changes.

visualGates.description: These CSS gates apply ACROSS ALL render modes. They never check render mode, render mode never checks them.

textXl.notes: Handled by html font-size, no separate CSS file

renderOverrides.description: Per-item overrides in content JSON. Optional. Only needed when an item breaks from the default rule.

keep.description: Props that would be stripped but should be kept for this item

override.description: Props to replace with different values for this render mode
